// diagnostic

E3311

Target `{target}` lacks the required `{capability}` capability.

What

Target `{target}` lacks the required `{capability}` capability.

Why

The selected target profile must state each machine service separately; a target triple cannot imply a UART, clock, entropy source, scheduler, allocator, startup provider, or MMIO device.

Fix

Select a typed target profile with a `{capability}` provider, or remove the reachable operation.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3311: tests/ui/target_missing_capability_e3311.stderr.

Error [jet.MissingTargetCapability]: Target `board.sensor_v1` lacks the required `Time.Wall` capability.
